title: Print a greeting
summary: Kotlin: Print a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: main is the starting function. println prints a value on a new line.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.
main is the entry point. println writes one string and a newline.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A program needs a main function to start here.
